text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Thump. Thump. Thump... My heart is<n>pounding. The
sweat sticking to my<n>back feels gross. Knowing
that one<n>choice here is gonna change my<n>whole
damn life... It's got me<n>nervous. Hesitant. Lost.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I feel like trash, but I feel so<n>alive. And
now—the cards are down.<n>Let's get this
blood-chilling game<n>started.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's been a couple months since I<n>started working
at Tracen Academy. I<n>haven't done anything of
much<n>interest yet, but I think I've pretty<n>much got
the hang of things.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The town, on the other hand, is still<n>fairly new to me.
I figure I might as<n>well have a walk around and get
to<n>know the place, but...
choice_data_list:
(This place looks kinda iffy... I should get out of the
alleys.)

(This place looks kinda iffy... I should get out of the
alleys.)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There's graffiti all around, and the<n>narrow street
ahead hardly seems<n>inviting. I start turning around,
looking<n>for a way back to the main street,<n>when—

text_block_list.name: Delinquent A
text_block_list.text:
Get back here! I know you. You're<n>that Nakayama
punk who used to<n>raise hell 'round here!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text:
Tch. I left that life behind me. Don't<n>go tryin' to
drag me back.

text_block_list.name: Head Delinquent
text_block_list.text:
Say what you want, but everyone<n>'round here
knows what you've<n>done. Even the boss says
you've got<n>guts—more than us, his own boys.

text_block_list.name: Head Delinquent
text_block_list.text:
Y'wanna know what he said when I<n>told him I'd
take you down? "No one<n>plays the game like that
risk-junkie.<n>Give it up or you'll get your ass<n>handed
to you." ...But I ain't forgivin'<n>you that easy.

text_block_list.name: Head Delinquent
text_block_list.text:
It's your fault everyone's lookin'<n>down on us! So
quit pretendin'<n>you've gone clean and let's settle
this!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As the man gets riled up, I see the<n>Umamusume's
ears droop back. Next<n>thing I know, I'm running out
between the two.

text_block_list.name: Delinquent A
text_block_list.text: The hell?!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent A
text_block_list.text: Hey... Is that idiot really gonna takeNakayama's place? They don't looklike they've played chicken ever!
choice_data_list: (How did I get myself dragged into this...)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After running my big fat mouth, the<n>delinquents
pulled me out to some<n>pier for a game of chicken.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And now I'm sat on one of their<n>motorcycles, the
rumble of the engine<n>reverberating through my core.
One of<n>them hands me his helmet, and I slide<n>it on.
choice_data_list:
(Once I twist the right handle, this thing's taking
off...)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text:
Hey. Your hands are shaking. Are you<n>sure you can
drive that?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text:
If you've got cold feet, no one'll<n>blame you if you
run. I mean, I'm a<n>complete stranger. You don't
owe me<n>anything.
choice_data_list:
I know, but I can't just leave you with those
delinquents.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text:
Well, wouldn't be the first time a<n>well-intentioned
idiot pulled a stunt<n>like this. Why do people like you
keep<n>jumping headfirst into danger?

text_block_list.name: Head Delinquent
text_block_list.text:
Listen up—the rules're simple. We<n>both drive
straight at the sea, and<n>whoever chickens out and
hits the<n>brakes first loses.

text_block_list.name: Head Delinquent
text_block_list.text:
You prove you've got guts, and I<n>swear we'll leave
your new pal<n>Nakayama alone. That good with you?

text_block_list.name: Head Delinquent
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I keep my word. Assumin'<n>you're still alive
when I'm done with<n>you.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text:
Tch. Quit tryin' to freak the poor idiot<n>out. Hey, you.
Take a deep breath and<n>listen to me for a sec.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text: If you get scared and start thinkin'maybe it's time to brake, it's not.Don't hesitate, just keep going. Theline between life and death is just aline in the sand.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text: If you're gonna do this, you've gottathrow out any doubts now. Lightenup, and ride free. Don't think aboutanything but winning—and keepfighting.

text_block_list.name: Delinquent A
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, psych yourself up all you want,<n>but we all
know you're not really<n>gonna floor it. Just don't
embarrass<n>yourself too bad.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The delinquents look me over,<n>grinning smugly.
Then, the guy<n>refereeing our contest comes over
behind us, and tosses a rock to be<n>our starting
signal.

text_block_list.name: Head Delinquent
text_block_list.text: DRIVEEE!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent A
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! That idiot's really going for it?!<n>They're
goin' way too fast!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent A
text_block_list.text: HEY, IDIOT! You got a death wish or<n>somethin'?!

text_block_list.name: Head Delinquent
text_block_list.text:
Tch. You're crazy. I'm not goin'<n>down with you!
...Dammit!
choice_data_list: (He braked! Now I can stop too!)
(He braked! Now I can stop too!)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I slam the brakes, way closer to thewater than that chicken got. Themotorcycle skids with a screech, justfeet—inches from...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There's a lurch as the wheel drops<n>off the edge
and the bike flips,<n>shooting into the air. The blood
boiling<n>in my veins freezes in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text: HOLD YOUR BREATH!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's like time stopped. Everyone's<n>frozen
solid—except the "Nakayama"<n>girl charging towards
me. She gains<n>speed with each step, leaping off the
pier like she's taking flight.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text: HRAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: She grabs on to the back of my shirtand yanks, hard. I'm pulled off thebike, choking for air, as it plunges intothe sea.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text: Panting... Hah. Hahaha! Well, thissucks. We're both soaked!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text: Hah... But we're alive. Haha... Damn.My heart's still going wild.
choice_data_list: Um, th-thank you. So... did I win?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text: Ah... Hehehe. You just drove off thepier, and your first worry is thegame? Man, you're outta your mind.Just look!

text_block_list.name: Head Delinquent
text_block_list.text: Hey, jump in and grab the bike!<n>Hurry!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text:
You got them scrambling—I'd say<n>that's a win.
C'mon, let's ditch 'em!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text:
You should be able to figure out your<n>way home
from here, right? See ya.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text:
I swear, I haven't had a thrill like that<n>in a while.
Haha...
choice_data_list: W-wait! Before you go, can I get your name?!
W-wait! Before you go, can I get your name?!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I want to thank her properly for<n>saving me, but she
doesn't turn back.<n>She just lifts a hand and waves,
walking off into the night.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Time passes, but the sensation of<n>flying off that
pier doesn't. I keep<n>going back to that alley, but I
never<n>find her. At this point, I'm half<n>convinced I
dreamed the whole thing<n>up, but then...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Teen
text_block_list.text: ...Sigh.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: It's her. Right here at the Tracen<n>tryouts!
